description: Drive issue→Done via an event subscription on com.mohist.workflow.run.completed (symmetric to EpicAutoDoneHandler), remove the now-redundant daily sweep + lazy read-path reconciliation, and drop the synthetic 'Done' stage cell from Web stage-progression surfaces.

tasks.title: Event-driven issue completion on workflow-run Completed
tasks.description: Add IssueWorkflowCompletionHandler : ICloudEventHandler under Events/Subscriptions/ with [Subscription(Type = EventCatalog.ReverseDns.WorkflowRunCompleted)], mirroring EpicAutoDoneHandler. It parses the workflowRunId from the CloudEvent source (via WorkflowEventSerializer.ExtractContextFromSource, like RunnerWorkflowTerminalStatusHandler), resolves the owning in-progress issue via a new IssueQuerier.GetIssueIdForWorkflowRunAsync(workflowRunId) reverse lookup (filtered to Status = 'inProgress', returns null if none), and dispatches IIssueGrain(issueId).CompleteWorkAsync(workflowRunId). Handler swallows+logs exceptions so a failure never propagates into the workflow-run commit. Only Completed is handled (single-type subscription). Idempotency is inherited from CompleteWorkAsync's existing status/workflowRunId guards.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueWorkflowCompletionHandler exists under Events/Subscriptions/, implements ICloudEventHandler, and is decorated with a single-type [Subscription] for WorkflowRunCompleted (not the pipe-separated terminal pattern).
IssueQuerier.GetIssueIdForWorkflowRunAsync filters Issues by WorkflowRunId = @id AND Status = 'inProgress' and returns null when no in-progress issue is bound.
The handler no-ops (debug-log + return) when the CloudEvent source yields no run id, and no-ops when the lookup returns null.
On a successful lookup the handler invokes IIssueGrain(issueId).CompleteWorkAsync(workflowRunId); handler exceptions are swallowed and logged with a warning (never rethrown into the publish path).

Specs assert: a Completed workflow run bound to an InProgress issue transitions the issue to Done through the event subscription alone under an injectable TimeProvider (no sweep advancement, no simulated read-path open).

Specs assert idempotency: duplicate delivery of com.mohist.workflow.run.completed after the issue is Done is a no-op (no throw, no re-transition, no field mutation); a mismatched workflowRunId is guarded out by CompleteWorkAsync.
Specs assert only Completed drives the transition: failed and stopped terminal states do not invoke CompleteWorkAsync (covered by the single-type subscription + a behavioral assertion).
Server npm test (dotnet test) is green with TreatWarningsAsErrors.
No call into IssueGrain is made for failed/stopped terminal events.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Events/Subscriptions/IssueWorkflowCompletionHandler.cs + IssueQuerier.GetIssueIdForWorkflowRunAsync + new spec test file under tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Events/Issue/. Observable: a Completed workflow run flips its bound issue to Done via the subscription.
tasks.notes: Mirror EpicAutoDoneHandler (shape: querier + IGrainFactory, sync dispatch, swallow+log) and RunnerWorkflowTerminalStatusHandler (run-id extraction from CloudEvent source). Do NOT detach onto a background task: the handler calls a different grain (IssueGrain) from the workflow grain's publish path, so no reentrancy/self-deadlock (same posture as EpicAutoDoneHandler→EpicGrain). The com.mohist.workflow.run.completed event carries no issue context, so issue resolution MUST be the reverse DB lookup on the indexed IssueRow.WorkflowRunId — do not plumb issueId into the event/aggregate.

tasks.title: Remove daily sweep + lazy read-path reconciliation; make GetWorkflowStatusAsync a pure query
tasks.description: Delete IssueWorkflowReconciliationService (Issue/Services/) and its AddHostedService<IssueWorkflowReconciliationService>() registration at MohistServiceRegistration.cs:74. In IssueGrain.GetWorkflowStatusAsync, remove the await ReconcileWithWorkflowTerminalStateAsync(...) call and the stale 'if the bus subscription missed the Completed event' comment; delete the ReconcileWithWorkflowTerminalStateAsync method entirely so the read path only queries _workflowQuerier.GetStatusAsync and projects (no write side-effect, CQS restored). Delete the now-dead IssueWorkflowReconciliationServiceSpecs test file (do not leave old/new tests co-existing) and add/extend a spec asserting the read path is a pure query.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueWorkflowReconciliationService.cs is deleted and no longer referenced anywhere.
services.AddHostedService<IssueWorkflowReconciliationService>() is removed from MohistServiceRegistration.cs and no other registration references the deleted type.
IssueGrain.GetWorkflowStatusAsync contains no call to ReconcileWithWorkflowTerminalStateAsync and performs no status mutation or reconciliation write; it only queries and projects.
The ReconcileWithWorkflowTerminalStateAsync method is deleted from IssueGrain.
The stale 'if the bus subscription missed the Completed event' comment is removed or rewritten to describe the new event subscription (T-001).
IssueWorkflowReconciliationServiceSpecs.cs is deleted (no old/new test coexistence).

A spec asserts: GetWorkflowStatusAsync for an InProgress issue whose bound run is Completed returns the completed status WITHOUT transitioning the issue to Done and WITHOUT invoking any reconciliation write; calling it repeatedly mutates no issue field.

Server npm test (dotnet test) is green; a grep for ReconcileWithWorkflowTerminalStateAsync and IssueWorkflowReconciliationService across packages/server returns no source references (only this openspec change doc excepted).
tasks.output: Deleted IssueWorkflowReconciliationService.cs + IssueWorkflowReconciliationServiceSpecs.cs; edited MohistServiceRegistration.cs and IssueGrain.GetWorkflowStatusAsync; pure-read-path spec. Observable: read path no longer mutates issue status; no daily sweep is registered.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 so the new event-driven path is the primary issue→Done route before the redundant fallbacks are removed (design: 'new handler + deletions ship together; new handler is primary'). This intentionally removes the automatic fallback: during the transition period (until the durable at-least-once event Non-Goal lands), a dispatch/handler failure can leave an issue stuck in InProgress requiring manual re-trigger — this is an accepted tradeoff, not a bug to fix here.

tasks.title: Remove synthesized 'Done' stage from Web stage-progression surfaces
tasks.description: Drop the synthesized terminal Done stage from all four stage-progression surfaces while retaining the WorkflowStage.Done enum member. WorkflowView.tsx: remove WorkflowStage.Done from WORKFLOW_STAGES and the Done branches in getStageStatus/getDefaultStage. SessionTimeline.tsx: remove 'done' from stageOrder and WORKFLOW_STAGES. IssueCard.tsx: drop the status===Done ? WorkflowStage.Done override and the Done label entry. IssueDetailPage.tsx: drop the [WorkflowStage.Done]: 'Done' label entry and the stage===Done → IssueStatus.Done derivation. Terminal state continues to be expressed as Integrate all-green + issue status pill. Update affected snapshots and tests.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowView.tsx WORKFLOW_STAGES contains exactly plan/build/check/integrate (no Done); getStageStatus and getDefaultStage have no Done-specific branches.
SessionTimeline.tsx stageOrder and WORKFLOW_STAGES contain exactly plan/build/check/integrate (no 'done').
IssueCard.tsx no longer overrides the displayed stage to WorkflowStage.Done for Done-status issues and has no Done label entry; stage is derived from real pipeline stages only.
IssueDetailPage.tsx stage label map has no WorkflowStage.Done entry and no stage===Done → IssueStatus.Done derivation.
The WorkflowStage.Done enum member is retained (only the places that add it to rendered lists/orders are changed).
Web typecheck (npm run typecheck -w packages/web) is green.
Web tests (npm run test:run -w packages/web) are green and any snapshots referencing a Done stage cell are updated/removed; no rendered surface shows a fifth 'Done' cell.
tasks.output: Edited WorkflowView.tsx, SessionTimeline.tsx, IssueCard.tsx, IssueDetailPage.tsx + updated snapshots/tests. Observable: stage bar / session timeline / kanban card / issue detail render only the four real stages; terminal state shown as Integrate all-green + issue status pill.
tasks.notes: Fully independent of the server tasks (separate subsystem, no API contract change) so it can execute in parallel with T-001/T-002. Keep WorkflowStage.Done in the enum to minimize churn across widely-referenced call sites; spec forbids re-adding it to any rendered list/order.
